lines: Hmph! You guys are all talk. Go and cool your heads a little!!
Hebiko grabbed the forcibly pacified ninja attackers with her octopus tentacles and tossed them into the pool.
How about some ink for good measure.
Don't do that. The pool will get dirty and we'll get stuck having to clean it.
Ah, that's right. Hebiko doesn't want to have to do that just for those birdbrains.
The birdbrains in question had gotten sopping wet and left in a hurry.
Uwuwuh, why did I have to go through all of this because of those morons? I'm not even a Fuma...
Shikanosuke-chan, you're terrible. He's your friend, right?
Yeah, but... I have a feeling that something like this is going to keep happening, and somehow I'm going to get caught up in it every time, you know?
I sympathized with Shikanosuke, who was prone to getting involved in trouble against his will, but brushed him off nonchalantly.
Hey, you, spectator over there. Would you get out here already.
Yukikaze appeared from the shadows of the locker room and cheekily stuck out her tongue.
You were watching us from over there?
I mean, I have nothing to do with the Fuma Clan quarrels.
Right right, you've got it rough, Shikanosuke. Hebiko-chan and Fuma too... You look like you're going through a lot.
It's because of what happened. I can't help it.
They were asking a bunch of stuff, and I was wondering about that too.
What are you going to do as the head of the Fuma Clan? You sidestepped it earlier.
I didn't really sidestep it. Honestly, I'm just a little lost on some things.
Because I still don't know anything.
As I told them, first we're going to capture Gaiza and find out what he's up to. Then we'll take it from there.
It's not my way to decide if things should go this way or that when I hardly have any information.
Hmmm... I guess that's fine then.
Surprisingly, Yukikaze nodded with a convinced look.
Judging from Yukikaze's personality, I thought she'd say I was being wishy-washy or something.
I'm the same. There's something I absolutely want to do, but I'm not quite sure what the best way to do it is yet...
Yukikaze cast her eyes downward as she spoke.
I was curious, but didn't dare to ask.
I was sure she wouldn't talk to me about it.
We had only known each other for a short time, but I could tell that much from her expression. Hebiko and Shikanosuke also seemed to be able to tell.
Alright, let's go grab something to eat! You only used your head, Fuma, but you're still hungry, right? I'm starving too.
